newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 27.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Prosecutors to question Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd's former chairman Kuniji Miyazaki and ex-chairman Tadashi Okuda in payoff scandal.
-- Nine major electricals and software entities agree on compensation for digital recording property rights.
-- Most firms did not apply to use Labour Ministry's subsidies for child care and nursing care.
-- Nomura Securities Co Ltd to file damages suit against its former president Sakamaki.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto indicates retaining ruling party secretary-general Kato.
